entries.en:
Rozol Cattlan the Prudent has asked for your assistance in the crafting of high-quality components for the Dezul Qualan's cockpit exterior. However, before you can gain access to the facilities necessary for the synthesis, you must first find a way to bribe the young Highwind Skyways representative in charge of overseeing the equipment. Rozol believes you may be able to achieve this with a saint carp─a rare type of fish living in the frigid waters of the Coerthas River to the west of the Observatorium. It is said that saint carp are best caught with moth pupae.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en:
Templeton is every bit as unscrupulous as advertised, and now you have full access to the Highwind Skyways temporary crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by Rozol and inspected by Templeton to synthesize two high-quality cockpit exterior components, and deliver the finished products to Ehcatl.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Production II wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Templeton.

entries.en: What? You believed these tender morsels for myself? Pah! It pains me to learn you think so little of good Templeton, my . A slice of fat carp on the plates of the right persons, and it won't be long before I'm transferred out of this frozen wasteland to somewhere the sky is blue and the sea bluer.

あっ、今の本音は聞かなかったことにしてくださいねっ！

entries.en: Very well, then. Feel free to use the facilities as you see fit. Just try not to damage anything. A lot of unnecessary paperwork that would be. Ah, and I suppose you shall be wanting these materials returned, as well. Hm? Did I inspect them thoroughly? I don't know. Did it appear that I did? Good then! <wink> <wink>

entries.en: If you need aught else, feel free to ask. I'll be right here charring this carp to perfection.

また使いたいときには、ひと声かけてくださいねっ！

entries.en: It appears you've completed that contraption of yours. I shall not ask what it is for if you promise to remove it from here at once. It would be simply tragic if one of my supervisors were to walk in and I had to tell them of how you threatened to bludgeon me with a frozen carp─two frozen carp─if I didn't allow you access to our equipment. <wink> <wink>

entries.fr: Tiens, vous êtes encore là ? Si vous avez terminé votre travail, je pense qu'il serait de bon ton d'aller livrer vos clients dans les plus brefs délais. Si jamais vous perdez quelque chose en route, revenez me voir !

もしも製作した品をなくしたりして、作りなおすときは、
私に声をかけてくださいねっ！

entries.en: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.

売却もできませんので、不用でしたら破棄してください。
